user.title: Add gateway
user.description: Which gateway do you want to add?

serial.title: USB connection
serial.description: Choose the serial port of the {model}.

data_description.path: Prefer the /dev/serial/by-id path, it survives reboots and re-plugging.

tcp.title: Network connection (ser2net)
tcp.description: Host and port of the ser2net server the {model} is connected to. The baud rate is set in ser2net, not here: {baudrate} baud for this gateway.

base_id.title: Base ID
base_id.description: The {model} did not report its base ID. Enter it (for example FF-AA-80-00); it is printed on the device or shown by PCT14. For the FAM14 it is read from its memory later, with the bus import.

bus_group.title: Bus
bus_group.description: Is this gateway on the same RS485 bus as an existing one? Gateways on the same bus form a bus group: commands for bus actors fail over between them.

zeroconf_confirm.title: Gateway found
zeroconf_confirm.description: A {model} was found at {connection}. Add it?

name.title: Name
name.description: Connected, base ID {base_id}. Give the gateway a name, for example by where it is or what it reaches.

data_description.name: Shown on the integration page and as the gateway device. Rename later in the entry's menu.

proxy_confirm.title: Gateway through a proxy app
proxy_confirm.description: The {app} app offers the gateway **{name}** at {connection}. Which model is behind it? Replay after restarts is switched on.

same_base_id.title: Same base ID
same_base_id.description: A gateway with the base ID {base_id} is already set up ({gateways}). Add this one as a second gateway with the same base ID? That is meant for e.g. two radios of one installation. Sender IDs are never assigned twice across the gateways, but an actuator taught in on one gateway only reacts to the other one's telegrams if it was taught in there too.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot open the connection. Check the port, host and baud rate.
error.invalid_base_id: Not a valid base ID. It lies between FF-80-00-00 and FF-FF-FF-80 and ends in 00 or 80.
error.invalid_id: Not a valid ID. Four hex bytes, for example 05-10-A2-B3, 05:10:A2:B3, 05 10 A2 B3 or 0510A2B3.
error.sender_invalid_id: Not a valid ID. Four hex bytes, for example FF-B7-44-81 or FFB74481.
error.sender_none: Enter at least one sender ID.
error.sender_blocked: Blocked until the teach-out of the removed device is confirmed.
error.weather_no_source: Choose at least one entity for the weather station.
error.wall_switch_invalid_id: Not a valid wall switch ID. Four hex bytes, for example FE-D8-12-34.

abort.already_configured: A gateway with this base ID is already set up.
abort.wrong_gateway: This is a different gateway (other base ID). Add it as a new gateway instead.
abort.gateway_not_loaded: The gateway is not loaded. Devices can be added once it is connected.

options.rocker_contact: Contact via rocker telegrams (FTS14EM, garage door …)
options.heating_actuator: Heating actuator, Home Assistant controls (FHK14, FAE14 …)

options.passive: Only when fully opened or closed anyway

options.std_a5_08_01: Standard · A5-08-01 Light, temperature and occupancy
options.std_a5_09_04: Standard · A5-09-04 CO2, humidity and temperature
options.std_d2_01_09: Standard · D2-01-09 Switching actuator with metering

options.default: Teach-in: put the actuator into learn mode (rotary switch LRN or learn button), then press the matching teach-in button on this device page.
options.psc: Teach-in: start the learn mode on the PSC (PSC132: touch about 3 s, PSC234: more than 5 s, LED flashes red), then within 15 s press "Teach in controller" on this device page. The PSC first sends a request of its own, which is ignored. Done when the LED flashes green 5 times.
options.cover: Teach-in: put the actuator into learn mode (FSB: function 180/200 for the controller, 10/30 for the direction rocker), then press the matching teach-in button on this device page.
options.heating_actuator: Teach-in: put the actuator into learn mode for a room controller, then press "Teach in controller"; for cooling also teach in the cooling switch.
options.virtual_contact: Teach-in: put the actuator into learn mode for a window contact (FSR14: any learn position; FUD14: LC2 = make contact, LC3 = break contact; FSB14: function 20/40, which also sets up the lock-out protection; FHK14: upper rotary switch at the right stop), then press “Teach in window contact”.
options.virtual_temperature: Teach-in: put the actuator into learn mode for a temperature sensor (FHK14: during teach-in the hysteresis switch sets the setpoint, middle position = 21 °C), then press “Teach in temperature”.
options.virtual_motion: Teach-in: put the actuator into learn mode for a motion sensor (FSR14: any learn position), then press “Teach in motion”.
options.virtual_rocker: Teach-in: put the actuator into learn mode, then press the button on this device page that it should learn.
options.bus: On the Eltako bus: for the actuator to send a confirmation, the FAM14's upper rotary switch must be at position 2 while teaching in.
options.vld_switch: Teach-in: press “Teach in (UTE)” on this device page, then put the actuator into learn mode within 60 s (e.g. the button on the actuator). It sends a query that Home Assistant answers. This needs an ESP3 gateway (USB300, MGW-ETH, generic ESP3); ESP2 gateways such as the FAM-USB cannot send the answer.
options.vld_cover: Teach-in: press “Teach in (UTE)” on this device page, then put the actuator into learn mode within 60 s. It sends a query that Home Assistant answers. This needs an ESP3 gateway (USB300, MGW-ETH, generic ESP3).
options.virtual_brightness: Teach-in: put the actuator into learn mode for a brightness sensor (FSB14: function 150 for the shading automatic; FSR14: any learn position, its upper rotary switch then sets the switching threshold), then press “Teach in brightness sensor”.
options.virtual_weather: Teach-in: put the actuator into learn mode for a weather station (FSB14: any learn function; it takes either an FAH60 or an FWS61), then press “Teach in weather station”.
options.virtual_scene: Teach-in: put the actuator into learn mode for a scene button (FSR14: 30, FUD14: LC4, FSB14: function 180/200), then press one of the scene buttons on this device page. Scenes are stored on the actuator as its manual describes.

cover_position_unknown.message: The position is unknown; open or close the cover fully first.

room_controller_read_only.message: This room controller is operated on site; its setpoint cannot be changed from Home Assistant.

energy_not_loaded.message: The Energy dashboard is not set up in Home Assistant. Open Settings → Dashboards → Energy once, then try again.

capture.name: Capture telegrams
capture.description: Records all telegrams for a while and writes them as JSONL to /config/enocean_eltako/. The files can be used as test fixtures.

config_entry_id.name: Gateway
config_entry_id.description: Only telegrams of this gateway; empty for all.

calibrate_cover.name: Calibrate cover
calibrate_cover.description: Drives the cover to the nearer end position to reset its tracked position, then back. With an unknown position it drives to the open end.

only_if_inaccurate.name: Only if inaccurate
only_if_inaccurate.description: Skip covers whose position is already known well (less than 10 points off).

add_energy_devices.name: Add meters to the Energy dashboard
add_energy_devices.description: Adds the electricity meters of your devices as individual devices to the Energy dashboard (with their power sensor, when the device has one). Meters that are already there stay as they are; gas and water meters are not added.

config_entry_id.name: Gateway
config_entry_id.description: Only the devices of this gateway; empty for all.

data_description.message_delay: Minimum time between two telegrams sent by this gateway.
data_description.mode: On demand: connected only when the bus group needs this gateway (failover, import), so PCT14 can use it in between.
data_description.repeater: Whether the gateway repeats telegrams of other devices (ESP3 only). Set on every connect.
data_description.discovery: Offer unknown senders this gateway receives as discovered devices.
data_description.proxy_replay: Only when this gateway is reached through the Device Proxy or EnOcean Proxy app: after every connect the app replays the telegrams that arrived while Home Assistant was restarting.

hidden.title: Hidden senders
hidden.description: Senders you hid. Pick the ones to list again when the gateway hears them.

abort.senders_shown: The selected senders are listed again when heard.

user.title: Add device
user.description: How do you want to add the device?

menu_option_descriptions.learn: Press the learn button or a button on the device, or switch the actuator locally. The kind is suggested from its telegram.
menu_option_descriptions.eltako: Pick it from the Eltako catalog.
menu_option_descriptions.enocean: NodOn, Permundo, Hoppe and other manufacturers.
menu_option_descriptions.eep: Any supported profile, for devices not in the catalog.
menu_option_descriptions.virtual: Home Assistant sends as a window contact, motion sensor, temperature sensor or rocker, e.g. so an HA window contact lowers the heating.
menu_option_descriptions.discovered: Senders this gateway heard that are not set up yet; the kind is suggested from the telegram.

menu_option_descriptions.model_virtual_contact: Follows a binary sensor; sends like an FTK (D5-00-01)
menu_option_descriptions.model_virtual_temperature: Follows a temperature sensor; sends like a room sensor (A5-02-05)
menu_option_descriptions.model_virtual_motion: Follows a binary sensor; sends A5-07-01
menu_option_descriptions.model_virtual_rocker: Four buttons in HA that send like an FT55 (F6-02-01)
menu_option_descriptions.model_vld_switch: NodOn SIN-2-1-01 and other D2-01 actuators
menu_option_descriptions.model_vld_cover: NodOn SIN-2-RS-01 and other D2-05 actuators

learned.title: Telegram received
learned.description: Received a telegram from {device_id} (profile {eep}). What kind of device is it?

eep.title: By EEP
eep.description: Named profiles first, then every other standard profile of the EnOcean Alliance by its code. Typing filters the list; a code such as A5-04-02 works directly too. Standard profiles become a device with one sensor per value, the other entries open the matching catalog entry.

device.title: Device
device.description:
Examples: {examples}. Receives {receive}; senders: {send}. The first sender ID is suggested from this gateway's pool; further senders are optional (leave empty). Teach each one in with its button.

{hint}

data.name: Name
data.status_request: Ask for the state at startup

data_description.device_id: ID of the device's telegrams, for example 05-10-A2-B3, 05:10:A2:B3, 05 10 A2 B3 or 0510A2B3 (actuators: the ID of their status telegrams).
data_description.time_opens: Full travel time from closed to open.
data_description.time_closes: Full travel time from open to closed.
data_description.routing: Which sender moves the cover. Positions always use the controller when it is set.
data_description.temperature_sensor: Sensor whose temperature is sent to the actuator (any temperature sensor in Home Assistant). Empty: Home Assistant sends only the setpoint, the thermostat taught into the actuator measures.
data_description.send_interval: How often it sends. Heating actuator: at least every 10 min, otherwise it goes into fault mode after 1 h. Virtual sensor: repetition on top of every change, 0 = only on change.
data_description.unavailable_when_silent: Show the entities as unavailable when the device was not heard for three times its usual interval.
data_description.status_request: Only for actuators that answer a confirmation request (FL62, FR62, FD62). Others keep their last state, marked as assumed, until they report.
data_description.calibration: Before an uncertain move, the cover first drives to the nearer end when its position may be off by more than 10 points.
data_description.fields: Values of the profile that become sensors.
data_description.sender_central: Optional when the rocker sender is set: without it Home Assistant switches with rocker presses (dimmers then without brightness, no state request at startup).
data_description.sender_cooling: Optional. Heating actuators switch to cooling on a taught-in switch press (0x50); Home Assistant repeats it every 10 min while the mode is Cool.
data_description.vent_time: Shutters with vent slots: seconds at the end of the down run in which only the slots close. Position 1 % is then 'down, slots open'. 0 = none.
data_description.tilt_time: Blinds: seconds for a full turn of the slats. Above 0 the cover becomes a blind with a tilt position; every run turns the slats first.
data_description.source: Entity whose state is sent. Contact: on = open.
data_description.when_unavailable: Safe value: send “open” so a lock-out protection still works, for example.
data_description.priority: Lock-out protection: the contact is sent ahead of all queued commands, so for example an “open” reaches a shutter actuator (FSB14) before a central down command.
data_description.sender_contact: The sender ID is also the ID of this virtual device; it stays fixed afterwards.
data_description.sender_temperature: The sender ID is also the ID of this virtual device; it stays fixed afterwards.
data_description.sender_motion: The sender ID is also the ID of this virtual device; it stays fixed afterwards.
data_description.channel: Output of the actuator (0 = first channel).
data_description.sender_vld: Reported to the actuator during the UTE teach-in.
data_description.weather_wind: Optional, any speed unit. Without it 0 m/s is sent.
data_description.weather_brightness: Optional, in lx; also sent as sun on all sides and for day/night (night below 10 lx).
data_description.run_time_tenths: Send controller run times in tenths of a second, precise for short moves and slats. Only for actuators that know this form (newer firmware); otherwise whole seconds, as the old eltako integration sent them.
data_description.invert: Contacts and window handles: on means closed. Switching actuators with reversed relay logic: commands and state are swapped.

rocker_buttons.name: Rocker sender: buttons
rocker_buttons.description: Which buttons Home Assistant presses with the rocker sender ID. Change them only if the ID is taught in on the right rocker or with top and bottom swapped.

data_description.rocker_on_button: A = left rocker, B = right; 0 = top, 1 = bottom. The teach-in button presses this one.
data_description.rocker_off_button: Usually the other half of the same rocker.

wall_switch_settings.name: Wall switch (receive, for actuators without feedback)
wall_switch_settings.description: Home Assistant listens to a wall switch taught into the actuator and sets the assumed state from its presses.

data_description.wall_switch: For actuators that do not report their state: the ID of a pushbutton taught into the actuator. Its presses then set the state (marked as assumed until the actuator reports).
data_description.wall_on_button: Same button for on and off: every press toggles.
data_description.wall_off_button: Same button for on and off: every press toggles.

status_channel_settings.name: Two-channel actuator
status_channel_settings.description: Only for actuators with two channels under one ID (e.g. FSR71NP-2x): set up each channel as a device of its own with the same ID. Fixed once the device is set up.

data_description.status_channel: Which status telegrams belong to this device. Commands go through its own sender IDs.

address.title: Device ID
address.description: Listen for a telegram (press a button on the device, or switch the actuator locally) or enter the ID.

learn_timeout.title: Nothing received
learn_timeout.description: No telegram from a new sender arrived. Try again or enter the ID.

measure.title: Measure travel times
measure.description: Home Assistant first opens the cover fully. Then it drives down: click Submit the moment the cover is fully closed (slats shut). Then it drives up: click Submit the moment it is fully open. The actuator reports the driven time to 0.1 s. Afterwards you can also measure the vent slot or slat turning time. Set the actuator's delay time (RV) at least to the measured time plus a margin, otherwise its end-position reports are not real end positions.

measure_down.title: Driving down
measure_down.description: Click Submit the moment the cover is fully closed.

measure_up.title: Driving up
measure_up.description: Click Submit the moment the cover is fully open.

measure_result.title: Measured
measure_result.description: Up: {time_opens} s, down: {time_closes} s, vent slots: {vent_time}, slats: {tilt_time}. Submit to save these times. The cover stands somewhere in the middle afterwards; drive it to an end once so its position is exact again.

measure_extra.title: Vent slots or slats
measure_extra.description: Optionally measure one more time. Home Assistant then closes the cover fully and drives up once more. Shutters with vent slots: the slots time. Blinds: the slat turning time.

measure_vent.title: Vent slot time
measure_vent.description: Click Submit the moment the slots are fully open, i.e. the shutter just starts to rise.

measure_tilt.title: Slat turning time
measure_tilt.description: Click Submit the moment the slats are fully turned open, before the blind starts to rise.

discovered.title: Discovered devices
discovered.description: Senders this gateway heard that are not set up yet.

data_description.hide: Not yours (a neighbour's, for example)? Hide it instead of adding it; it is not listed again. Show it again in the gateway's settings.

error.invalid_id: Not a valid ID. Four hex bytes, for example 05-10-A2-B3, 05:10:A2:B3, 05 10 A2 B3 or 0510A2B3.
error.already_configured: This device ID is already set up on this gateway.
error.sender_invalid_id: Not a valid ID. Four hex bytes, for example FF-B7-44-81 or FFB74481.
error.sender_none: Enter at least one sender ID.
error.sender_blocked: Blocked until the teach-out of the removed device is confirmed.
error.unknown_eep: This profile is unknown. Pick an entry from the list or type a code such as A5-04-02.
error.weather_no_source: Choose at least one entity for the weather station.
error.wall_switch_invalid_id: Not a valid wall switch ID. Four hex bytes, for example FE-D8-12-34.

abort.gateway_not_loaded: The gateway is not loaded. Devices can be added once it is connected.
abort.measure_failed: The cover did not report the open end position.
abort.no_discovered: No unknown senders were heard yet.

progress.learn: Waiting up to {seconds} s for a telegram. Press a button on the device or switch the actuator locally now.

climate_silent.title: {name} has not been controlled for 45 minutes
climate_silent.description: Home Assistant could not send setpoint and temperature to {name} for 45 minutes (gateway offline?). After 1 hour without a telegram the heating actuator switches to its fault mode with a fixed heating cycle.

device_silent.title: {name} not heard for {hours} h
device_silent.description: {name} usually reports regularly but has not been heard for {hours} hours. Last received by: {gateway}. Check its battery or power supply and the radio range.

gateway_disconnected.title: {name} is disconnected
gateway_disconnected.description: The connection to {name} ({connection}) has been down for more than 5 minutes; Home Assistant keeps retrying. Check the USB cable or the ser2net service and the network.

base_id_changed.title: {name} reports a different base ID
base_id_changed.description:
The gateway reports base ID **{reported}**, but **{configured}** is set up. Was the gateway or its radio module replaced? The actuators know the old sender IDs, and the new gateway cannot send from them: commands from Home Assistant do not arrive.

Either connect the original gateway again, or set this gateway up anew and teach the actuators the new sender IDs.

bus_slow_confirmations.title: Bus actuators on {name} confirm slowly
bus_slow_confirmations.description: The actuators on this gateway confirm commands after **{seconds} s** on average (median). According to Eltako the FAM14 passes confirmations on right away only in **operating mode 5**, with a device list made by PCT14. Check the operating mode on the FAM14 (see its manual) and create the device list with the PCT14.

custom_devices_invalid.title: Errors in the EnOcean device definitions

proxy_outdated.title: Update the EnOcean Proxy app
proxy_outdated.description: The gateway {gateway} runs through EnOcean Proxy {version}. This integration needs version {minimum} or newer (older versions announce only one of several gateways to Home Assistant). Update the app under Settings → Apps.

connection_unstable.title: {name} keeps losing its connection
connection_unstable.description: The connection to {name} ({connection}) dropped {drops} times within {minutes} minutes. Usually another program or integration opens the same port and the two take it from each other. Stop the other one or give it its own gateway; with ser2net, allow only one client.

connection_unstable_users.title: {name} keeps losing its connection
connection_unstable_users.description: The connection to {name} ({connection}) dropped {drops} times within {minutes} minutes. These integrations may use the same port: {users}. Disable them or give them their own gateway; two integrations on one port take it from each other.

gateway_silent.title: {name} does not answer
gateway_silent.description: {name} is connected ({connection}) but does not answer, so no telegrams arrive. Many network gateways such as the MGW-ETH serve only one connection: close the other programs that use it (for example Symcon or another Home Assistant), or restart the gateway. The repair goes away by itself once it answers.
